name: Breadcrumb
description: Semantic breadcrumb markup: nav, ordered list, links, and a current page marked with aria-current.
intent: Show where this page sits in the hierarchy, and offer a way back up.

props.name: separator
props.hint: Optional. Declared in the component source.

props.name: asChild
props.hint: Renders the child element instead of the default one, merging props and styles. Use for links that must look like this component.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

requiredAttributes: aria-label="Breadcrumb" on the nav — set by the component
aria-current="page" on the last item — set by BreadcrumbPage
notes: The final item must be BreadcrumbPage, not BreadcrumbLink. Linking to the current page is a common and pointless error.
Separators are aria-hidden so they are not read as content.
BreadcrumbEllipsis is decorative. If the hidden levels matter, put them in a ui:dropdown-menu behind it.

usage: Hierarchies three or more levels deep
When users arrive from search and need orientation
doNotUse: As a step indicator for a wizard — breadcrumbs describe location, not progress
When the hierarchy is only one level deep

agentRules: The last item is always BreadcrumbPage.
Use asChild to integrate your router.
Put collapsed levels behind a real menu, not a bare ellipsis.
